value.rationale: The invariant \(R\) is the endpoint of a natural twisted Kähler--Einstein continuity method and quantitatively measures failure of Kähler--Einstein behavior. Determining its complete limiting law on a natural exhaustive canonical family gives a structural asymptotic benchmark, not merely a finite enumeration. The exact survival function, mean \(\log(3)/3\), and sharp finite extremizers are directly reusable in comparisons of stability across dimensions.
